title: Anattā2; bāhiram
text: 3 Rūpā bhikkhave anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || 4-7 Saddā || Gandhā || Rasā || Phoṭṭhabbā || 8 Dhammā anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 9 Evam passam || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātāti || || [page 004] 4 SAḶĀYATANA-SAṂYUTTA [XXXV. 7. 3
